[h3]Hello Arcane Hunters.
I finally managed to have a stable and [b]playable[/b] version, far from being the final product but closer and closer. 

In this version I present the Book: [b][i]Introduction to Arcanism[/i][/b].
This book contains important information about the occult universe.
How to collect evidence, a list of 15 creatures and more important information![/h3]

[b]So far this is the list of creatures: [/b]

[list]
[*] Gnome 
[*] Dragon 
[*] Unicorn 
[*] Fairy 
[*] Saber tooth 
[*] Ghost 
[*] Giant Spider 
[*] Mermaid 
[*] Phoenix
[*] ​Treant
[*] Headless Mule
[*] Werewolf
[*] Troll
[*] Gryffon
[*] Harpy
[/list]

[b]The equipment is extremely useful in your hunts, we currently have: [/b]

[list]
[*] Compass 
[*] Watch 
[*] Grimoire
[*] Lamp 
[*] Arcane Crystal
[*] Spyglass
[*] Monocle
[/list]

[b]Observing the clues left by the creature it is possible to discover its species, we currently have [/b][list]
[*] information about: 
[*] Mushrooms 
[*] Claw Mark 
[*] Footprint 
[*] Magic Dust 
[*] Scale 
[*] Bubbles 
[*] Fur 
[*] Feathers 
[*] Firemark
[/list]
